sections.heading: 1. Before and during set-up
lines: ① After the drive, walk for 5 min first.
② Carry gear close to your body, in loads.
③ Peg in from a half-kneel on a mat.
④ Swap knees and stand tall between pegs.

caption:
Lulu's weekend away started with a long drive, then straight into carrying gear and hammering pegs. By the time the tent was up, the back was stiff.

Bending over and over can tire the back quickly. After the drive, walk for five minutes first. Carry gear close to your body in smaller loads, peg in from a half-kneel on a mat, swap knees and stand tall between pegs.

Pain spreading down a leg, numbness or weakness, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio ⛺

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
